definition: pp512_A = llama-bench -p 512 -n 0 -t 6 -r 5 on the calibration file Qwen3-1.7B-Q8_0 (tok/s); F2_A = 2 * P_active(cal) * pp512_A is computed in analysis/ (P_active from the PROTOCOL script)
notes: Run by the author from a plain Command Prompt via hostA-downloads/run_f2.bat with the Claude app closed (RAM). Earlier attempt with the app open was stopped after ~40 min (free RAM 0.56 GiB, paging) and not recorded. V10 paging counters were NOT sampled in this run; stability (CV about 4%) and the run time suggest no paging, but this is not verified. Cross-check: 2*1.7e9*11.0 = about 37 GFLOP/s, equal to F1_A (37.3).
